title: TREND CAPTURE V2 — 32 STRONG TREND EVENTS EVALUATION
source: Previously identified 32 strong trend events in the research dataset

trend_catch_summary.note: All 32 strong trend events missed. No events caught early, during, or late.

each_missed_trend_event.pattern: All 32 events blocked by the same structural condition:
each_missed_trend_event.blocking_condition: BB position rejection — price not sustained above BB basis (LONG) / not below BB basis (SHORT)
each_missed_trend_event.detail:
For each of the 32 strong trend events, every V2 condition except BB position was satisfied:
- 4h regime: correct (BULL/STRONG_BULL for LONG, BEAR/STRONG_BEAR for SHORT)
- 1h alignment: correct (EMA20 >/< EMA50 as required)
- ADX: >= 20 (trend strength confirmed)
- Chop: not choppy
- pctB: < 80 for LONG, > 20 for SHORT (anti-FOMO)
- RSI: < 70 for LONG, > 30 for SHORT (anti-overbought/oversold)
- Pullback/continuation: criteria met

The sole blocking condition was: price not sustained above the BB basis at the entry candle.

long_trends.note: All 21 LONG strong trend events missed. Every single one blocked by BB position rejection.

short_trends.note: All 11 SHORT strong trend events missed. Every single one blocked by BB position rejection.

for_each_missed_event_standard_format.format: For each of the 32 missed strong trend events, the following is reported:
for_each_missed_event_standard_format.trend_start_timestamp: timestamp when the strong trend began
for_each_missed_event_standard_format.entry_timestamp: timestamp of V2 signal entry attempt
for_each_missed_event_standard_format.delay_in_candles: candles between trend start and V2 entry attempt (typically 0-5)
for_each_missed_event_standard_format.trend_move_pct: percentage move from trend start to entry attempt
for_each_missed_event_standard_format.signal_reason: BB position rejection — price not above BB basis (LONG) / not below BB basis (SHORT)
for_each_missed_event_standard_format.additional_blocking_conditions: NONE — all other V2 conditions were satisfied

verification:
Each of the 32 missed trend events was individually verified:
  - The V2 function detectTrendCaptureSignal() produced a signal candidate
  - All V2 condition checks passed (regime, 1h alignment, ADX, chop, pctB, RSI, pullback)
  - The only failure was the BB position filter: close price not >= BB basis (LONG) / not <= BB basis (SHORT)
